About this model

Each run uses the same rules and parameters. Both begin with 72 vegetation cover points and 24 rabbit units; baseline starts with 9 fox units, while the removal run sets foxes to zero.

  • Vegetation regrows logistically toward carrying capacity K = 100, with a small seed-bank term.
  • Rabbits reproduce based on available vegetation and are limited by food; they also die naturally and through fox predation.
  • Foxes gain from rabbits they consume and die naturally. At zero rabbits, foxes decline; at zero foxes, rabbits have no predator loss.
  • Integration step: 0.05 model years. Populations are clamped at zero; vegetation is capped at K.

dV/dt = 0.90V(1 − V/100) + 0.35(1 − V/100) − 0.018RV

dR/dt = 0.80R[V/(20 + V)] max(0, 1 − R/(0.9V + 5)) − 0.28R − 0.50FR/(12 + R)

dF/dt = 0.50FR/(12 + R) − 0.15F

V is vegetation cover, R is rabbit abundance, and F is fox abundance. One animation runs 50 model years in about 20 seconds. Outcomes depend on assumptions and timescale.

A simplified teaching model, not a forecast of a real ecosystem.
